reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing multi-project groups and letting an agent read, write, list, and run commands across registered project folders in one conversation.

summaries.zh: 在同一会话中管理多个项目文件夹，并让智能体对已注册文件夹执行文件读写、目录查看和命令运行。
summaries.en: Manage multiple project folders in one conversation and let the agent read, write, list, and run commands within registered folders.

capabilities: Reads files and lists directories within registered project folders
Writes files within registered project folders
Runs shell commands such as git, npm, and builds in registered project folders
Provides an HTTP API for project-group management
